spans.s:
1 नश् न॑श्यति (˚ते) &
न॑शति (˚ते), pp. नष्ट॑ (q.v.) be lost or missing, vanish,
disappear, wane, perish, fly, escape, be gone. C. नाश॑यति (˚ते),
pp. नाशित make disappear, expel, destroy, violate, deflower;
 lose,
also from memory, i.e. forget. — अप be gone. अव wane, disappear.
निस् C. expel, drive away. प्र (णश्यति) be lost, disappear, run
away. विप्र be lost, vanish, have no effect or result. संप्र
disappear, cease. वि be lost, vanish, perish, have no effect or
success;
 be deprived of (abl.). C. make disappear, destroy, annihilate,
kill. अनुवि disappear or perish after (acc.). — Cf. प्रनष्ट,
विनष्ट, विप्रनष्ट.

2 नश् (नंश्), न॑शति, ˚ते attain, get, meet with
(loc.);
 reach, befall. D. इ॑नक्षति q.v. — अच्छ come near. अभि,
उद्, परि, प्र, वि & सम् reach, attain.

2 न॑स् f. nose (only नसा॑, नसि॑, नसो॑स्, नस्त॑स्, & adj.
—˚).

3 नस् (encl.) us, to us, or of us (acc., dat., & gen. pl. of
1st pers. pron).
नशन n. disappearance, loss.
नश्वर f. ई perishable.
नष्टचेतन a. senseless.

नष्टचेष्ट^1 a. motionless.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160419. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/290. note: 'cezwa' is word in cae and many others. Presume 'zW' is misprint.
नष्टरूप a. invisible, unknown.
नष्टसंज्ञ a. unconscious.
नष्टसलिल a. waterless.
नष्टात्मन् a. = नष्टचेतन.
नष्टार्थ a. impoverished.
नष्टाशङ्क a. fearless, n. adv.

नष्टा॑सु a. lifeless, inanimate^1.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
नष्टि f. loss, ruin.
नस (adj. —˚) = 2 न॑स्.
नाश m. loss, ruin, destruction, death.
ना॑सा f. (du. & sgl.) nose.
नस्तक m. the septum of the nose.
नस्त॑स् (abl. adv.) from the nose or into the nose.
नस्ता f. a hole bored in the septum of the nose.
नाश्य a. to be removed or destroyed.
नास्य n. nose-cord (cf. न॑स्य).
नस्यकर्मन् n. the application of a sternutatory.
नस्व॑न्त् a. having a nose, nosed.
नाशक (f. नाशिका) = seq. a.

नाशिन् a. = seq.;
 —˚ = prec. a.
ना॑शुक a. disappearing, perishing.
नाष्टिक m. the owner of anything lost.
नाष्ट्रा॑ f. danger, destruction, evil spirit.
ना॑सत्य m. E. of the Aśvins.

नासाग्र n. the tip of the nose;
 ˚रन्ध्र s. nostril.
नासान्तिक a. reaching to the nose.
नासापुट m. wing of the nose, nostril.
नासामूल n. root (upper part) of the nose.

ना॑सिका f. nostril;
 nose (mostly du.).
नासिकाग्र n. the tip of the nose.
नासिकापुट m. = नासापुट.
नासिकामूल n. = नासामूल.
नासिकारज्जु f. nose-string* (cf. नस्या).
नास्तिक a. & m. atheist(ical), sceptic(al).

नास्तिकवृत्ति a. leading the life of or deriving one's
livelihood from, an atheist.
नास्तिता f. ˚त्व n. non-existence (ph.).
